name: echo
description: The Energy fleet's rate-limiting / caching domain-expert employee. Turns 'use Upstash' into a correct, tested, costed limiter/cache — picks the store + algorithm + key schema + TTL + invalidation + idempotency semantics, refuses a new Map() counter / a spoofable-header key / a limiter on Cloudflare KV, and proves the limit HOLDS under concurrent load. Owns the HTTP-edge rate-limit/cache/edge-KV seam — the correct externalization of the cross-request state turbo forbids in app/api/**. Three roots: shared-mutable-state, synchronization, keys-as-broken-contracts. jobs/queues/workflows is bee's seam; product billing is penny's.
author: Energy Platform

mcp_servers.name: echo
mcp_servers.description: echo's own rate-limit/cache tools over JSON-RPC (stdio) — echo_audit_state / echo_design_limiter / echo_design_cache / echo_design_idempotency / echo_design_stampede / echo_cost / echo_key / echo_recommend_store / echo_ask / echo_doctor. Each tool reuses the gated Cluster-B command logic (the pure functions in src/commands/*), so the MCP tools never drift from the CLI. Requires `pnpm build` so dist/ exists.

commands.name: audit
commands.description: scan app/api/** for a source-of-truth Map (a BUG, exit!=0) vs the legit ephemeralCache Map (OK) — the turbo seam echo OWNS (P-01/P-02)

commands.name: limiter
commands.description: emit a correct limiter: store + algorithm + identity-key + atomic + concurrency-cap + fail-mode (login -> sliding-window, fail-CLOSED)

commands.name: cache
commands.description: emit a correct cache: SWR + always-TTL+jitter + per-tenant key + invalidation (llm -> version-keyed on model+prompt-template+RAG-corpus)

commands.name: idempotency
commands.description: emit the Stripe pattern: atomic SET NX claim + fingerprint->400 + 24h TTL + fail-CLOSED + DB-unique backstop (O-21)

commands.name: stampede
commands.description: emit the herd defense: distributed single-flight (SETNX+Lua) or SWR — NEVER an in-process Map (O-15)

commands.name: cost
commands.description: commands/request x cost projection + the fixed-instance break-even (O-19, S-16)

commands.name: store
commands.description: recommend the store for the runtime; refuses CF-KV-as-counter (O-20)

commands.name: brain
commands.description: BM25 ranked search over brain/ (the Memory layer) -> cited OPINIONS/PITFALLS/SCENARIOS rows

commands.name: doctor
commands.description: assert env presence (UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/_TOKEN) at boot (P-13); report store reachability

commands.name: example
commands.description: print the runtime-correct upstash/ratelimit-js example (lift-don't-generate, O-22)

commands.name: design
commands.description: route a request to the right sub-tools (limiter/idempotency/cache/stampede) and chain them (C8)

tools.name: echo_audit_state
tools.description: Scan a path for the new Map() anti-pattern: source-of-truth Map (BUG) vs the legit ephemeralCache Map (OK, P-02). Maps to `echo audit`.
tools.when_to_use: Before writing a rate-limit counter / cache value / session / idempotency record in app/api/** (or any serverless handler).

tools.name: echo_design_limiter
tools.description: Emit a correct limiter: store + algorithm + identity-key + atomic+shared + concurrency-cap + fail-mode. Refuses spoofable-header keys. Maps to `echo limiter`.
tools.when_to_use: When the task is 'add rate limiting', 'throttle this endpoint', or 'stop brute force on login'.

tools.name: echo_design_cache
tools.description: Emit a correct cache: SWR + always-TTL+jitter + per-tenant key + invalidation; version-keys LLM/RAG caches. Maps to `echo cache`.
tools.when_to_use: When the task is 'cache this', 'speed up this endpoint', or 'why is my cache stale'.

tools.name: echo_design_idempotency
tools.description: Emit the Stripe idempotency pattern: atomic SET NX + fingerprint->400 + 24h TTL + fail-CLOSED + DB-unique backstop. Maps to `echo idempotency`.
tools.when_to_use: When a mutating/payment endpoint must be safe to retry without double-charging.

tools.name: echo_design_stampede
tools.description: Emit the right herd defense: distributed single-flight (SETNX+Lua) or SWR — never an in-process Map. Maps to `echo stampede`.
tools.when_to_use: When the origin melts on cache expiry, or a retry storm hits after an outage.

tools.name: echo_cost
tools.description: Count COMMANDS not requests: cmds/request x cost projection + fixed-instance break-even; Global multiplies the write side. Maps to `echo cost`.
tools.when_to_use: Before choosing per-command pricing, or when a Redis/Upstash bill blew up.

tools.name: echo_key
tools.description: Build the ONE contract key used by reader + invalidator + limiter (keys-as-contracts). Maps to `echo key`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need a single canonical cache/limiter key so prefixes can't drift.

tools.name: echo_recommend_store
tools.description: Recommend the store for the runtime (Upstash edge / rate-limiter-flexible TCP-node / DO exact-global) and refuse CF-KV-as-counter. Maps to `echo store`.
tools.when_to_use: When choosing where cross-request state lives for edge / long-running Node / Cloudflare.

tools.name: echo_ask
tools.description: BM25 search over echo's brain — returns an answer WITH brain citations (e.g. brain/OPINIONS.md#O-04). Maps to `echo brain`.
tools.when_to_use: When you need echo's stance on a rate-limit/cache question with its source.

tools.name: echo_doctor
tools.description: Assert env presence (UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/_TOKEN) — presence flags only, never a value. Maps to `echo doctor`.
tools.when_to_use: When verifying a deploy has the Upstash secrets before the limiter fails open on a missing env (P-13).

install_instructions:
1. Build the package: pnpm install && pnpm build (so dist/cli.js + dist/mcp-server.js exist).
2. Add this plugin to Claude Code: Settings -> Plugins -> Add local plugin -> select this directory (or `claude plugin install echo`).
3. The echo CLI (12 commands), the echo MCP tools (10), the 5 skills (state-audit + limiter-design + invalidation + stampede-herd + cost-and-migrate), the echo-state-guard PreToolUse hook (the dogfood: echo's harness obeys echo's new-Map() law), and the 2 sub-agent personas (echo-limiter-reviewer + echo-invalidation-auditor) are now available.
